description: A smartphone lies on a green surface with a white charging cable nearby, set against a plain backdrop. The right hand reaches forward to grasp the phone as a right-hand object and lifts it, while the left hand slides along the cable to bring the connector up; the left hand then plugs the cable into the bottom of the phone, making the cable a left-hand object while the phone stays in the right hand, and the right hand lowers the now-connected phone back onto the surface and releases it.
